name: Maniwa Shouko
source: One of the childhood gang's members, a taciturn and elusive girl. Shouko is often mistaken to be a doll whenever she is silent. Often bullied during childhood, however, Shouko doesn't show any signs of misery. She is a member of the breeding club, which takes care of the animals at the school. Her favorite animal is rabbit, and she is always carrying around a stuffed rabbit. Doesn't like men, and claims to hate all men.
